Name: Arctic Combat Mission Briefing
Desc:
Dossier ID: AG-POL-240701
Issued By: Babylonia Combat Command
Recipients: Arctic Support Forces, Advance Units

1. Mission Background
20 days ago, current disruption caused by the Red Tide led to large-scale ice shelf fractures in the Arctic region.
These fractures damaged coastal ports of the Arctic Route Union, forced mass civilian displacement, and exposed the sealed the old Sophiasburgh containing Punishing entities.
2. Enemy Assessment
Following the unsealing of the old Sophiasburgh, large numbers of Corrupted have emerged from within.
On-site scans have detected signals suspected to belong to Ascendants.
3. Combat Deployment
Babylonia has dispatched support forces in accordance with protocol, with Gray Raven Squad and Dark Aries Squad designated as core units.
Subsequent reinforcements must first rendezvous with Babylonia's advance forces and the Arctic Union army to operate under unified command.
4. Core Objectives
Eliminate Corrupted swarms and ensure the safety of displaced civilians.
If Ascendants are encountered, all combat data must be synchronized in real time. Solo pursuit is strictly prohibited.

Name: "The Frostheart Emperor" and "The Frostheart Warlords" Intelligence Brief
Desc:
Dossier ID: AG-INT-POL-008-1
Source: Oral accounts from the Border Commune (Antonov, Sergey), Dark Aries reconnaissance records

I. Core Institutional Framework
The "Monarch-Duke" power structure of the Arctic Route Union during the old Sophiasburgh era.
II. Frostheart Emperor System
Status: Supreme ruler of the Arctic Route Union. Succession is determined by "Sophiasburgh royal blood," making the Emperor both the spiritual symbol of the Arctic and its central authority.
Core Functions: Oversees military mobilization and resource allocation; holds final decision-making power, and is deeply bound to the governance of Sophiasburgh.
Current Status: Zack claims the title of "Sixth Frostheart Emperor" and has demanded that the Arctic region be brought back under his rule.
III. Frostheart Warlords System
Status: The highest-ranking military commanders directly under the Frostheart Emperor. A total of three individuals, regarded as the strongest generals within the Union, and answerable only to the Emperor.
Selection Criteria: Determined solely by combat capability, regardless of origin or faction.
Known Members: Fyodor (former Warlord, with a negative service record, currently aligned with Zack's faction); Dragon-man (details unknown); and a possible link to Amberia (details unconfirmed).
PopUpName: "The Frostheart Emperor" and "The Frostheart Warlords" Intelligence Brief

Name: "Amalgamation" Technology Briefing I
Desc:
Dossier ID: AG-INT-POL-009-1
Information Source: Past Combat Records
Classification: Internal Reference

Core Designation:
A control technology developed by the former Arctic Route Union. Due to catastrophic disasters caused in the past, it has become a "forbidden power" that Arctic factions avoid discussing.

Name: "Malkuth" Frame Intelligence Summary
Desc:
Dossier ID: AG-INT-POL-010-1
Intelligence Category: Special Frame Analysis
Information Source: Dr. Mina's testimony, Rosetta's battlefield feedback
Classification: Internal Reference (Information integrity pending verification)

I. Development Background
Technological Origin: The core design is derived from manuscripts left by Rosetta's grandfather, Dr. Puff. These documents reference "Amalgamation Technology," but the original development purpose remains unclear.
Subsequent Progress: Led by Dr. Mina with support from Dr. Bear, focusing on "construction and completion." Current experiments concentrate on resolving startup failures.
II. Current Frame Status
Completion Level: Incomplete—currently relies on "non-standard methods" for activation, with core functions still offline.
Stability: M.I.N.D. compatibility remains flawed and requires establishing a "M.I.N.D. Connection" with the Commandant to achieve minimal stability.
Compatibility Technology: Capable of mounting "Anti-Amalgamation Modules," with compatibility still under active testing.

Name: Situation Assessment Brief: New Sophiasburgh Rear Areas
Desc:
Dossier ID: AG-INT-POL-011
Information Source: Logistics personnel testimony, operation report records

I. City Origin
After the Border Commune rejoined the Arctic Route Union, Union Forest Guards endured severe conditions to select a site and jointly lay the foundations for this city.
II. Core Situation
Serving as a rear logistics hub for the frontlines and a civilian settlement, the ongoing war has pushed the city into a barely sustainable state marked by "manpower shortages, slow infrastructure development, and unstable morale." Combined with natural and technical hazards, internal stability risks continue to rise.
PopUpName: Situation Assessment Brief: New Sophiasburgh Rear Areas

Name: Dark Aries Tactical Dossier
Desc:
Dossier ID: AG-TAC-POL-012
Intelligence Category: Battlefield Tactical Analysis (Arctic Rescue Operations Special Project)
Information Source: Simon's Battlefield Command Records

I. Tactical Core Positioning
Facing battlefield conditions that include high-threat individuals such as the Frostheart Warlords alongside large-scale Corrupted swarms, Simon proposed the following response: relying on strongholds to steadily construct a defensive system, replacing short-term engagements with sustained attrition.
II. Tactical Core Logic
Enemy Advantages: The Frostheart Warlords possess powerful breakthrough capabilities, and Corrupted forces exist in overwhelming numbers, making direct confrontation unfavorable to our side.
Our Limitations: Allied forces are a mixed formation of Babylonia Constructs and Arctic Route Union soldiers, with insufficient coordination proficiency and no unit capable of independently countering the Frostheart Warlords.


If you don't aim to win, you cannot lose —Special Note

Name: Intercepted Intelligence: The Origins of Amalgamation Technology
Desc:
Information Source: Unknown
Note: The material consists of fragmented records. Some details require further verification.

According to an intercepted experimental log kept by a scholar in the old Sophiasburgh, the origin of "Amalgamation Technology" traces back to a mysterious email titled "A Control Scheme Adapted for Arctic Conditions":
The message was sent roughly one month before the first sporadic Punishing infection reports appeared in the Arctic. The sender address appeared as garbled code, making it impossible to trace.

The content contained only fragmented algorithm snippets, explanations of mechanical control logic, and a peculiar note—"The basic framework for 'swarm coordination' must be completed in combination with the characteristics of Arctic machinery".

The email was initially received by three scholars specializing in Arctic mechanical systems. After testing the algorithms on small-scale Arctic machines in their laboratories, they successfully produced the first rudimentary form of what would later be known as "Amalgamation."
PopUpName: Intercepted Intelligence: The Origins of Amalgamation Technology

Name: Frostheart Warlord - Rumyantsev Intelligence Brief
Desc:
Dossier ID: AG-INT-POL-013
Intelligence Category: Analysis of High-Threat Enemy Individual
Information Source: Border Commune (Antonov) oral account, battlefield records,

I. Core Profile
One of the Frostheart Warlords, a militant general who once commanded the majority of the Arctic Route Union's forces. He currently operates an anomalous frame equipped with Kowloong technology. His identity, combat capability, and technological origins remain largely unknown.
II. Known Information
Preliminary reconnaissance detected Kowloong technology traits, including limb joint architecture and energy response patterns. However, Rumyantsev belongs to the former Arctic Route Union power structure (the Frostheart Warlords) and shows no confirmed affiliation with Kowloong forces, leaving the origin of the frame in question.

Name: Frostheart Warlords - Dulova Intelligence Brief
Desc:
Dossier ID: AG-INT-POL-014
Intelligence Category: Analysis of High-Threat Enemy Individual
Information Source: Unknown

I. Core Profile
The technical backbone of the Frostheart Warlords and one of the earliest researchers of Amalgamation tech. A firm believer in "combat application first," she rose through the ranks by driving the militarization of Amalgamation tech.
II. Key Intelligence
Path to Ascension: Following the Amberia incident, Dulova took the lead in developing a series of next-generation Amalgamators, ultimately securing her position within the Frostheart Warlords as its technological authority;
Battlefield Characteristics: The earliest among the Frostheart Warlords to undergo modification using a new Amalgamator. To validate system stability, she directly reused a substantial portion of data from the Amberia frame.

Name: Arctic Heritage Foundation Intelligence Brief
Desc:
Dossier ID: AG-INT-ORG-007
Intelligence Category: Analysis of Neutral Technological Organization
Information Source: Arctic scholar interview records, Foundation public project statements, alliance forces logistical technical documents

I. Core Profile
A technological organization formed organically by Arctic scholars, guided by the mission of uncovering lost legacy technologies, repairing gaps in Arctic technological development, and fostering a new Arctic technology ecosystem. It currently stands as a key force in technological research and knowledge preservation within the Arctic region.

II. Key Figure: Mina
The Foundation's de facto leader, combining a scholar's technical insight with a manager's ability to coordinate resources:
Technological Philosophy: Firmly believes that "old heritage is the stepping stone to new development." Values the archaeological recovery of legacy Arctic Route Union technologies, such as Amalgamator tech and special alloy forging, while emphasizing adaptive modification to meet present needs, and firmly opposing pure technological revivalism.
Resource Integration: Through years of accumulated connections and deep familiarity with Arctic ruins, Mina is able to mobilize funding, equipment, and dispersed technical personnel to drive large-scale heritage excavation and restoration projects.

Name: Spiritual Symbol "Sophiasburgh"
Desc:
Dossier ID: AG-INT-EMO-002
Intelligence Category: Identity Analysis
Source: Civilian interview records, observations from New Sophiasburgh reconstruction, frontline soldier accounts

Core Positioning: Sophiasburgh—The Spiritual Totem of Arctic Patriotism
For the Arctic population, "Sophiasburgh" has long moved beyond the idea of a physical city. It has become a concrete symbol of the Arctic Route Union's spirit, as well as the central anchor of identity and patriotic sentiment for the Arctic community. This sense of belonging is not sustained by slogans, but by memories passed down through generations and practiced in everyday life.

Name: Sophiasburgh Civil Unrest Incident Record
Desc:
Dossier ID: AG-INT-EVT-009
Intelligence Category: Arctic Historical Conflict Records
Source: Fragmented Administrative Archives of the old Sophiasburgh

I. Causes of Civil Unrest
After the full-scale outbreak of the Punishing Virus, core survival resources in the old Sophiasburgh were monopolized by nobles and the upper class, prioritizing the survival of privileged groups. Civilians in the outer city lacked basic protection, leading to sharp rises in infection rates and deaths from freezing and starvation. Repeated civilian petitions calling for "resource sharing" and "opening inner-city shelters" were rejected by the ruling class. With their right to survive pushed to the brink, riots finally erupted across the city.
II. Impact of the Unrest
Civilians stormed supply warehouses and defensive posts controlled by noble guards, resulting in the fall of three key districts in the outer city. Noble residential zones faced direct security threats, while the city's overall defensive capacity was weakened by internal strife. The Corrupted exploited the chaos and advanced toward the outer-city perimeter.
III. Pacification Measures
The upper echelon of the old Sophiasburgh urgently activated General Zack, authorizing him to deploy outer-city garrison forces and small-scale mechanical combat units to intervene—

Name: Arctic Bionic Whale Intelligence Brief
Desc:
Dossier ID: AG-INT-MECH-008
Intelligence Category: Arctic Special Machine Unit Analysis
Source: Arctic Heritage Foundation Documents, Coalition Battle Records, Technicians' Testimonies

I. Core Positioning
Developed through extensive research by the Arctic Route Union, this large-scale multifunctional Arctic machinery—centered on the flagship unit, Lead Whale Derek—integrates combat, coordination, and strategic transport functions into a single platform. It embodies the "swarm tactics" doctrine prevalent prior to the creation of Amalgamators.
II. Background and Traits
Design Intent: Developed to resolve Arctic machinery issues: inefficient scheduling, and coordination flaws. Designed by mimicking whale pod social behavior.
Hierarchical System:
Derek (Lead Whale): Integrates thousands of computational modules and coordinates over 10,000 mechanical signals. It functions as a scheduling hub only and does not control consciousness, analogous to a "mobile command center."
Subordinate Units (20-30 units): Operate under Derek's guidance, capable of independent or coordinated assault and transport missions. Each unit is equipped with a deployment bay in its ventral section (a feature previously exploited by enemy forces to deploy Corrupted).
Core Functions: Combat (missiles, ice-breaking systems), coordination (signal interference suppression, previously sustained long-term suppression of Amberia), transport (extreme cold endurance).

Name: Ascendant "Duryodhana" Intelligence Brief
Desc:
Dossier ID: AG-INT-ELT-011
Intelligence Category: High-Threat Enemy Ascendant Analysis
Source: Battle Records
Classification: High-Threat Surveillance

I. Identity
Ascendant intervening in the Arctic war, who appears to share a tactical alliance with the Frostheart Emperor. Direct perpetrator of the Hetero-Creature infestations during the war, with suspected connection to the incident of Babylonia's fall. Poses a high physical and psychological threat to alliance forces through violence.
II. Key Traits
Combat Style: A berserker who employs brute force to breach defenses and physically subdue opponents (e.g., grabbing the light sword barehanded, immobilizing Rosetta by pinning her arms). Routinely utilizes primal attacks like headbutts and exhibits formidable damage resistance.
III. Key Associations
Sophiasburgh Battlefield: Intervened in the standoff between Rumyantsev and Rosetta; summoned Hetero-Creatures to surround alliance forces and subdue Rosetta through brute force.
Babylonia's Fall: Voluntarily acknowledged involvement. While direct evidence is currently lacking, demonstrated hostility establishes clear suspicion. Listed as primary suspect.

Name: Ultimate Amalgamator (Zack) Capability Intelligence Brief
Desc:
Dossier ID: AG-INT-MECH-012
Intelligence Category: Enemy Core Unit Capability Analysis
Source: Battle Records
Classification Level: Maximum Threat

I. Core Positioning
Zack, as the Ultimate Amalgamator, dominates the battlefield by controlling machinery, the Corrupted, and Hetero-Creatures. He is a direct source of battlefield chaos.
II. Core Capabilities
Memetic Manipulation: Utilizes his frame's black box to issue commands such as "obey" and "attack." Its control spans Arctic machinery, Corrupted/Hetero-Creatures (unifying their attack patterns, even compelling self-destruction to form defensive barriers), and Constructs (causing M.I.N.D. disruption, with severe cases leading to complete subjugation).
Global Information Flow Amalgamation: Employs mediums like the red aurora to achieve "invisible surveillance" and real-time command transmission, enabling seamless tactical coordination of dominated units.
III. Combat Characteristics
Indiscriminate Control: Makes no distinction between friend or foe (affecting both the Frostheart Emperor faction machinery and alliance forces), using only "compatibility" as the criterion. However, the specific activation methods and hidden conditions remain entirely unknown.

Name: Rosetta (Ultimate Amalgamator) Capability Intelligence Brief
Desc:
Intelligence Category: Allied Key Unit Capability Analysis
Source: Sophiasburgh Battle Records, M.I.N.D. Synchronization Data, Derek's Cooperation Logs

I. Core Positioning
Unlike Zack's frame, a control-type of forced Amalgamation, Rosetta's Malkuth operates as a sharing-type Amalgamator. It establishes voluntary consciousness connections with Arctic machines and allied forces, enabling cooperative engagement through mutual awareness and distributed capability sharing. This allows coordinated resistance against Zack's global control network.
II. Core Capabilities
M.I.N.D. Resonance
Instead of forced manipulation, it establishes consciousness connections with commandants, Arctic machines such as Derek, and allied Constructs. This synchronizes knowledge and awareness between all parties, enabling autonomous coordination without direct commands while maintaining operational stability.
Adaptive Combat Transformation
Maintains the function of dual combat transformation. The humanoid form is optimized for close-quarters assault, while the centaur form prioritizes mobile coordination, which enables rapid traversal of the battlefield, real-time ability transfer, casualty evacuation, and strategic redeployment of key assets.
III. Intelligence Gaps
After the full activation of the black box, the upper limits of matrix sharing capabilities remain unknown.

Name: From Sophiasburgh to the Arctic Route Union
Desc:
ID: AG-ARCH-GEO-021
Type: Historical Record of the Arctic Route Union (ARU) Core Settlement
Source: ARU Golden Age administrative remains, Arctic geological survey reports, first-generation resident oral histories

I. Core Profile
Since the beginning of the Golden Age, Sophiasburgh has served as the capital and central hub for the entire region:
Administrative Decision-Making Center: ARU's highest deliberative venue, bringing together representatives from city-states and settlements to review cross-regional policies.
Technology Convergence Site: Home to top research teams.
Energy and Population Hub: Coordinated energy distribution across the Arctic region and attracted settlers from all regions. By the late Golden Age, it stood as a city with unmatched regional influence and defensive strength.
II. Historical Status and Administrative Structure
Political System and Power Distribution: Upon the ARU's founding, an imperial system was established and maintained, centered on the "Frostheart Emperor." The House of Representatives, speaking for individual settlements, exercised half of the decision-making authority, forming an administrative framework of "centralized coordination with democratic checks and balances".
Post-Punishing Changes: After the outbreak of the Punishing Virus, Sophiasburgh was exposed to escalating Corrupted threats and, due to multiple compounding factors, ultimately sank beneath the frozen sea.

Name: Zack (Frostheart Emperor) Post-War Supplementary Intelligence Brief
Desc:
Dossier ID: AG-INT-CHAR-012-1
Intelligence Category: Enemy Core Figure Post-Battle Analysis
Source: Rosetta's Testimony, ARU Genealogical Fragments, On-Site Investigation

I. Core Identity and Background Supplementation
Lineage and Career: Descendant of the Frostheart Emperor collateral line (distant relation, outside the core succession). Served initially as an astronaut before transferring to military service.
Military Profile: Rose as a hawk-faction commander known for hardline stances and decisive command. Rapid promotion was earned through martial achievements. Cultivated significant popular support via repeated demonstrations of integrity and justice, coupled with a dignified bearing.
Power Ascent: During the period of civil unrest, led a rebellion of young officers, motivated by dissatisfaction with the reigning Frostheart Emperor's governance. The revolt was later suppressed by the then-Warlord Rumyantsev. The subsequent transformation of their relationship into one of sovereign and vassal remains unexplained.
II. Current Status
Confirmed deceased. Suspected connection to [—].
PopUpName: Zack (Frostheart Emperor) Post-War Supplementary Intelligence Brief

Name: About Puff
Desc:
Dossier ID: AG-INT-CHAR-027-1
Type: Profile Summary
Sources: Rosetta's testimony, fragmented records of the Arctic Route Union, frame design drafts, Arctic scholar research

I. Background
Former captain of the Arctic Route Union Armed Operations Squad. Resigned after uncovering the inhumane experiments conducted on civilians under "Amalgamation Technology" and recognizing its fundamentally oppressive nature.
II. Creations and Actions
After leaving office, he consolidated personal weapons expertise and Arctic combat experience, and combined reverse-engineered "Amalgamation Technology" data provided by followers to secretly design the prototype frame "Malkuth." The surviving frame design manuscripts, noted for their forward-thinking concepts and technical depth, earned the creator the honorary title "Dr. Puff" among Arctic scholars such as Mina.

Name: "Unknown Musical Piece"
Desc:
Dossier ID: AG-INT-EMO-003
Intelligence Category: Record File
Information Source: Rosetta, Gray Raven Commandant, Coalition Testimony

This musical recording was recovered in the old Sophiasburgh by the Gray Raven Commandant and accompanying personnel. After examination, no hidden information was found, and it is believed to be a standard remnant artifact.
The piece carries a mournful tone, focusing on the sins of those who came before, and the descendants who passively inherit that burden.
"Guilt turns into wind and snow that blankets the world. Every soul walks within it as a solitary pilgrim."
